description: Pure scraping pipeline for pkg.go.dev package pages (src/core only, no vscode import): an HTML tree builder on top of the existing tokenizeHtml, an allowlist HTML sanitizer with link/image rewriting, URL/path validation helpers, and parsePackageDetail that extracts header fields, aside checks, repository/links, sanitized README, sanitized Documentation and the GOOS build-context options. Must handle both the saved sample shape (absolute links with ?GOOS=windows) and the LIVE shape (root-relative /x links, ?tab=... query-relative links, #fragment links, bare boolean attributes like `selected`). Independent of FEAT-002/003; later FEATs depend on it. See .agents/tasks/detail-tab-plan.md sections 1, 4, 6.
steps: Create src/core/htmlTree.ts: parseHtmlTree(html: string): HtmlElement (synthetic root named '#root') built from tokenizeHtml (src/core/htmlTokens.ts). Types HtmlElement {kind:'element', name, attrs: ReadonlyMap<string,string>, children: HtmlNode[]} and HtmlText {kind:'text', text}. Void elements: copy the VOID_ELEMENTS set from src/core/resultsParser.ts. Start tag pushes (unless void/selfClosing); end tag closes the nearest open ancestor with the same name (popping the elements above it), ignored if none is open. Cap depth at 256: when the stack is at the cap, new elements are appended to the cap-depth node without being pushed. Export helpers findFirst(node, pred), findAll(node, pred), textContent(node) (concatenated text, whitespace collapsed + trimmed), hasClass(el, cls), attr(el, name). All traversals iterative (no recursion deeper than the cap) and the function never throws (returns whatever was built on error).

Create src/core/detailUrl.ts: isValidImportPath(path) (string, 1..512 chars, segments split on '/', no empty segment, no '.' or '..' segment, chars only [A-Za-z0-9._~+-]; '@' and '?' '#' are rejected) and packageDetailUrl(path, goos?) returning {ok:true,url}|{ok:false,reason:'invalidPath'|'invalidGoos'} where url is `https://pkg.go.dev/<path>` plus `?GOOS=<goos>` when goos matches /^[a-z0-9]{1,16}$/; verify the result with isPkgGoDevHttpsUrl from src/core/searchQuery.ts.

Create src/core/htmlSanitize.ts: sanitizeNodes(nodes: readonly HtmlNode[], ctx: {baseUrl: string}): string implementing EXACTLY the allowlists in plan section 6 (allowed tags; dropped-with-content tags; unknown tags unwrapped; allowed attributes per tag; class tokens /^[A-Za-z][\w-]*$/; id value /^[\w:.\-]+$/ output prefixed 'pd-'; a: href resolved with new URL(raw, baseUrl), only http:/https:/mailto:, fragment or same-page-with-hash -> '#pd-<hash>', GOOS/GOARCH query params removed for pkg.go.dev URLs, always rel='noopener noreferrer'; img: src must resolve to https: else the img is dropped, always loading='lazy' referrerpolicy='no-referrer'). Re-escape text (& < > ") and attribute values. Add a small extra-entity decode pre-pass for text (copy reg trade hellip mdash ndash rarr larr laquo raquo middot bull times ldquo rdquo lsquo rsquo). Export resolveLink(raw, baseUrl): {kind:'fragment', id:string} | {kind:'external', url:string} | undefined for reuse by the scraper. Iterative or depth-capped traversal (tree depth is already capped at 256). Never throws.

Create src/core/packageDetail.ts: export Link, PackageDetail (shape in plan section 4) and parsePackageDetail(html: string, requestedPath: string): PackageDetail | undefined. Put every selector in one SELECTORS table at the top (style of src/core/resultsParser.ts). Extract: title (h1[data-test-id=UnitHeader-title]); chips (span.go-Chip inside .go-Main-headerTitle only); importPath (a[data-test-id=UnitHeader-breadcrumbCurrent] text, else button.js-clipboard[data-to-copy], else requestedPath); version Link (a inside [data-test-id=UnitHeader-version]; text from aria-label after 'Version: ', else anchor text minus the .go-textSubtle label; url via resolveLink against https://pkg.go.dev/<requestedPath>); published (text of [data-test-id=UnitHeader-commitTime] minus leading 'Published:'); licenses (all a[data-test-id=UnitHeader-license]); imports and importedBy (aria-label value after ': ', else anchor text minus subtle label; url from href); checks (each ul.UnitMeta-details > li that contains details > summary: label = textContent(summary), ok = first img in the summary has alt 'checked'); repository (.UnitMeta-repo a, text = link text, url = href); links (ul.UnitMeta-links a); readmeHtml (sanitizeNodes of children of the first element with class Overview-readmeContent, undefined when empty); docHtml (same for first element with class Documentation-content); buildContext from select.js-buildContextSelect options ({value,label}), selected = option with the 'selected' attribute else the first option, omitted when there is no select or no options. Missing fields are omitted, never thrown. Return undefined only when neither the h1 title nor an article.go-Main-article exists. Wrap in try/catch returning undefined.

Create fixtures in test/fixtures/package-detail/: (a) sftp-sample.html = trimmed copy (a few KB to ~40 KB) of sample-pages/package_detail.html containing header.go-Main-header (lines ~445-560), aside UnitMeta (lines ~566-690), the README block (UnitReadme, ~1461-1495), the UnitBuildContext select and the first ~60 lines of Documentation-content (index + constants + one function), keeping the original absolute `?GOOS=windows` links; (b) live-style.html hand-written in the LIVE shape observed on pkg.go.dev (root-relative '/github.com/spf13/cobra?tab=licenses' and '/syscall#O_RDONLY' links, query-relative '?tab=versions', '#pkg-overview' fragments, bare `selected`/`hidden` attributes, a select with NO selected option, imports/importedby aria-labels like 'Imported By: 195,884', a page without README and without build-context select); (c) hostile.html with script/iframe/object/embed/form/style/svg, onerror/onclick attributes, javascript:/JaVaScRiPt:/'javascript:'/tab-split/data:/vbscript: hrefs, srcset, style attrs, id='postMessage', name attrs, unbalanced tags, <base>, <meta http-equiv>, unknown tags. Tests must not read sample-pages/.

Add tests: test/unit/htmlTree.test.ts (nesting, void elements, stray end tags ignored, implicit close on mismatched end tag, depth cap with a 10_000-deep input does not throw/overflow, textContent whitespace); test/unit/detailUrl.test.ts (valid paths incl. 'os', 'net/http', 'github.com/pkg/sftp/v2', 'gopkg.in/yaml.v3'; invalid: '', '..', 'a/../b', 'a//b', 'a b', 'a?x', 'a#x', 'a@v1', 513 chars; goos valid/invalid and URL shape); test/unit/htmlSanitize.test.ts (every rule in plan section 6 using hostile.html and small inline cases, link resolution cases for root-relative, query-relative, fragment, same-page hash -> '#pd-x', GOOS param stripped, mailto kept, javascript:/data: dropped, img non-https dropped, ids prefixed, entities like © rendered as '©'); test/unit/packageDetail.test.ts (sftp-sample.html: title 'sftp', chips ['package','module'], importPath 'github.com/pkg/sftp/v2', version 'v2.0.0-alpha2', published 'May 4, 2026' (normalised spaces), license 'BSD-2-Clause' + absolute url, imports '20', importedBy '1', checks = [Valid go.mod file ok, Redistributable license ok, Tagged version ok, Stable version not ok], repository 'github.com/pkg/sftp' url 'https://github.com/pkg/sftp', links include 'Open Source Insights', readmeHtml contains '<h3' with id 'pd-readme-sftp' and no '<script', docHtml present, buildContext {selected:'windows', options: linux/windows/darwin/js with labels linux/amd64 ... js/wasm}; live-style.html: all URLs absolute https, build-context selected falls back to 'linux' (first), no README -> readmeHtml undefined, missing buildContext case, unrecognised page ('<html></html>') -> undefined, truncated page does not throw); test/unit/properties/dt01-sanitize-allowlist.test.ts (fast-check: for arbitrary concatenations of tag/attr/text fragments including hostile ones, re-tokenise the sanitizer output with tokenizeHtml and assert every start tag name is in the allowlist, every attribute name is in the allowed set, no attribute name starts with 'on', no href/src value starts with a scheme other than http(s)/mailto/#).

Add the opt-in live smoke test test/unit/detailLive.test.ts using `describe.skipIf(process.env.GOGET_LIVE !== '1')`: fetch https://pkg.go.dev/os, /golang.org/x/sys/unix, /github.com/spf13/cobra, /github.com/pkg/errors through PkgGoDevSearchClient(nodeHttpsTransport) from src/vscode/searchClient.ts with AbortSignal.timeout(30000); assert each parses (title non-empty, version present), buildContext defined for the first three and undefined for pkg/errors, docHtml present, no '<script' / ' onerror=' in readmeHtml/docHtml, and that parsing the 2.2 MB x/sys/unix page finishes in under 5 seconds. Run it once with network and record the outcome in findings; fix selectors in packageDetail.ts if the live shape differs from the plan.

Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`; fix everything. Commit locally (branch feat/detail-tab if currently on main) staging only the new src/core files, test files and fixtures by explicit path, message `feat: scrape pkg.go.dev package pages with sanitized README and docs`.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test` passes including the new htmlTree, detailUrl, htmlSanitize, packageDetail and dt01 property tests, and all pre-existing tests
parsePackageDetail on the sftp fixture returns the header, checks, repository, links, README, docs and buildContext {selected:'windows'} described in the steps
parsePackageDetail on the live-style fixture resolves root-relative and query-relative links to absolute https://pkg.go.dev URLs and selects 'linux' when no option has `selected`

sanitizeNodes output for the hostile fixture contains no script/iframe/object/embed/form/style/svg, no on* attributes, no style/srcset/name attributes, and no javascript:/data:/vbscript: URLs; ids are prefixed 'pd-'
`$env:GOGET_LIVE='1'; npx vitest --run test/unit/detailLive.test.ts` passes against the live site (or the failure is recorded in findings with the selector fix applied)
No new runtime or dev dependency added to package.json; no `vscode` import under src/core
findings: Committed on branch feat/detail-tab (5dbc1e4, not pushed). VERIFICATION: `npm run typecheck` exit 0. `npm test`: 535 passed, 1 failed; the single failure is PRE-EXISTING and unrelated: test/unit/searchSmoke.test.ts 'media/search.css contains no hard-coded colors' flags `border: 1px solid var(--vscode-contrastBorder, transparent)` in media/search.css (no tracked file was modified by this FEAT; all 105 new tests pass). Live: `$env:GOGET_LIVE='1'; npx vitest --run test/unit/detailLive.test.ts` PASSED 5/5 against the live site (os, golang.org/x/sys/unix, github.com/spf13/cobra, github.com/pkg/errors); parse time of the 2.2 MB x/sys/unix page is ~1.3 s in the test (probe: parse of os/cobra/errors 18-34 ms). No selector fixes were needed. LIVE-SHAPE NOTES: os is 'package' + 'standard library' chips, version text 'go1.27.3', repository 'cs.opensource.google/go/go', links contain 'Report a Vulnerability' (no Open Source Insights); os/x-sys/cobra have buildContext (selected 'linux' with no GOOS, 'windows' with ?GOOS=windows, verified), pkg/errors has none; live os has no README (readmeHtml undefined); live docHtml begins with section.Documentation-overview containing a Documentation-toc, size 40-230 KB. Live docs contain h3 ids like pd-pkg-overview and `href="#pd-..."` self links. EXPORTS FOR FEAT-002/003: src/core/htmlTree.ts (parseHtmlTree, findFirst, findAll, textContent, hasClass, attr, MAX_TREE_DEPTH=256, types HtmlElement/HtmlText/HtmlNode); src/core/detailUrl.ts (isValidImportPath, packageDetailUrl(path, goos?) -> {ok:true,url}|{ok:false,reason:'invalidPath'|'invalidGoos'}, type PackageDetailUrlResult); src/core/htmlSanitize.ts (sanitizeNodes(nodes, {baseUrl}), resolveLink(raw, baseUrl) -> {kind:'fragment',id}|{kind:'external',url}|undefined, types SanitizeContext/ResolvedLink); src/core/packageDetail.ts (parsePackageDetail(html, requestedPath), types Link, PackageDetail, BuildContextOption, PackageCheck). DEVIATIONS / DETAILS: (1) resolveLink takes the base URL string (not a ctx object). (2) Sanitized fragment hrefs are `#pd-` + encodeURIComponent(id) (so ':' becomes %3A); the webview should do getElementById(decodeURIComponent(rest)) as planned. A fragment link whose target id was dropped by the id regex dangles harmlessly. (3) findFirst/findAll exclude the starting node itself. (4) PackageDetail.title falls back to the last segment of importPath when the h1 is missing; version/imports/importedBy/repository/links are omitted (not empty) when absent, `licenses`, `checks`, `links`, `chips` are always arrays. (5) Header Link urls keep `?tab=...` (only GOOS/GOARCH are stripped, and only on pkg.go.dev URLs); `pageUrl` = https://pkg.go.dev/<requestedPath> WITHOUT GOOS, even when a GOOS fetch was made, so FEAT-002 should track the current goos in the view model (buildContext.selected is authoritative). (6) Extra validation beyond the plan (still within the allowlist): width/height/colspan/rowspan/start must be 1-6 digits, align must be letters, dir only ltr/rtl/auto, lang /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,35}$/. (7) Known quirk: the tokenizer leaves unknown entities literal, so a source `&copy;` (literal text '©') is decoded to a copyright sign by the extra-entity pre-pass. (8) After the depth cap, unpushed elements are tracked per tag name so their end tags are ignored. (9) Because one fixture cannot both have a select with no selected option and no select, the 'no select' and 'no options' cases are derived from live-style.html in tests via regex removal. (10) Fixtures: sftp-sample.html is ~40 KB trimmed from the sample (header, aside, README, build-context select, index prefix, constants, first function); hostile.html is a fragment (no <html>) parsed directly with parseHtmlTree + sanitizeNodes. Nothing under src/core imports vscode; package.json unchanged.
